datasets.title: Resultados Piloto MIRA Adaptado Ola Invernal Colombia 2022
datasets.description: Este conjunto de datos contiene los resultados del piloto MIRA Adaptado aplicado en 9 municipios de Colombia en el marco de la ola invernal de Colombia de 2022. El piloto ha sido implementado haciendo uso de la herramienta Premise de recolección de información. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/resultados-piloto-mira-adaptado-ola-invernal-colombia-2022]

lineage.description: Primary observational data on humanitarian impacts from the 2022 Colombian winter wave (ola invernal) collected through the Premise information gathering tool across 9 municipalities. The adapted MIRA (Multi-Cluster Initial Rapid Assessment) methodology was applied to document direct impacts on affected populations during this flood event.
